messages.subject: set priors for MCMC sampling
messages.body_plain:
How does one set priors for MCMC sampling?

And if one doesn't what are the default values?

Thanks

messages.subject: RE: [TMB users] set priors for MCMC sampling
messages.subject_clean: [TMB users] set priors for MCMC sampling
messages.body_plain:
Priors will have to be set from the cpp template.

Default is thus no prior (i.e. improper uniform distribution).

From: tmb-...@googlegroups.com [tmb-...@googlegroups.com] on behalf of Joseph Thorley [j...@poissonconsulting.ca]
Sent: Sunday, October 09, 2016 11:40 PM
To: TMB Users
Subject: [TMB users] set priors for MCMC sampling

How does one set priors for MCMC sampling?

And if one doesn't what are the default values?

Thanks

--

messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] set priors for MCMC sampling
messages.subject_clean: [TMB users] set priors for MCMC sampling
messages.body_plain:
Also note that if you want to put uniform priors on you will have to bound the parameter in the cpp template, with e.g., a logistic contrainst. You cannot (as of now) use bounds on the R side like you can with the optimizer.

I will be making some updates to the MCMC functions for TMB over the next months, so keep an eye out for those and please provide any feedback through the issue tracker.

Thanks,
Cole
